en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Safwan, from Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan ‘Al-Maazy’ (the 7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘The committers of the major sins, all of them, when the Penalty (Hadd) is established twice upon them, they would be killed (after) the third’.
